title: box-decoration-break - Layout - Tailwind CSS
content_text:
LAYOUT box-decoration-break Utilities for controlling how element fragments should be rendered across multiple lines, columns, or pages. Class Styles box-decoration-clone box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-slice box-decoration-break: slice; EXAMPLES Basic example Use the box-decoration-slice and box-decoration-clone utilities to control whether properties like background, border, border-image, box-shadow, clip-path, margin, and padding should be rendered as if the element were one continuous fragment, or distinct blocks: box-decoration-slice Hello World box-decoration-clone Hello World Hello
